D/ IMP SEV ALE XAND AVG ; R/ PMT [---] COS III PP

Silver coin. Denarius of Severus Alexander (222-235), Sear volume 2 no. 7910, RIC volume 4 part 2 no. 101, mint of Rome issue of 230. Obverse description: Youthful bust with bum-fluff beard below chin, laureate right. Obverse inscription: IMP SEV ALE XAND AVG. Reverse description: Sol standing left with right arm raised holding globe in left. Reverse inscription: PMT [---] COS III PP. Diameter:…
